table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.customicode, 
	itemname= item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock     = 0, 
	totalstock= 0, 
	assgcode  = 1, 
	qtysale=item.saleqty,
	bonus=item.bonusqty,
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	s.quotationcode,   
	s.icode,   
	s.itemflatdisc,
	RowId=s.RowID,
	s.itemdescription,
	s.gcode,
	s.packunits,
	s.saleprice,
	s.salestax,  
	s.bonusqty,
	unitsalestax=s.unitsalestax,
	GSTPerc=s.GSTPErc,
	s.qty,
	s.discperc,
	claimablediscperc=s.claimablediscperc,
	saleorderqty = CASE :ar_populationmethod WHEN 1 THEN ISNULL(S.saleorderqty, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	saleorderbonus = CASE :ar_populationmethod WHEN 1 THEN ISNULL(S.saleorderbonus, 0) ELSE 0 END
FROM
	Item, 
	(SELECT 
		T.quotationcode,
		T.itemflatdisc,
		T.itemdescription,
		T.gcode,
		T.packunits,
		T.saleprice,
		T.salestax,  
		T.unitsalestax,
		T.GSTPErc,
		T.Qty,
		T.BonusQty,
		T.discperc,
		T.claimablediscperc,
		T.ICode, T.RowID, SaleOrderQty=SUM(T.SQty), SaleOrderBonus=SUM(T.SBonus)
	FROM 
		(SELECT 
			QD.quotationcode,
			QD.itemflatdisc,
			QD.itemdescription,
			QD.gcode,
			QD.packunits,
			QD.saleprice,
			QD.salestax,  
			QD.unitsalestax,
			QD.GSTPErc,
			QD.Qty,
			QD.BonusQty,
			QD.discperc,
			QD.claimablediscperc,
			SD.ICode, 
			RowId=SD.QuotationRowID, 
			SQty= SUM(SD.LooseQty), 
			SBonus= SUM(SD.BonusQty)
		FROM
			QuotationDetail QD, SaleOrderDetail SD
		WHERE
			QD.quotationcode BETWEEN :ar_QuotationCode1 AND :ar_QuotationCode2 AND
			QD.ICode = SD.ICode AND
			QD.RowID = SD.QuotationRowID
		GROUP BY 
			QD.quotationcode,
			QD.itemflatdisc,
			QD.itemdescription,
			QD.gcode,
			QD.packunits,
			QD.saleprice,
			QD.salestax,  
			QD.unitsalestax,
			QD.GSTPErc,
			QD.Qty,
			QD.BonusQty,
			QD.discperc,
			QD.claimablediscperc,
			SD.ICode, 
			SD.QuotationRowID
		UNION
		SELECT 
			QD.quotationcode,
			QD.itemflatdisc,
			QD.itemdescription,
			QD.gcode,
			QD.packunits,
			QD.saleprice,
			QD.salestax,  
			QD.unitsalestax,
			QD.GSTPErc,
			QD.Qty,
			QD.BonusQty,
			QD.discperc,
			QD.claimablediscperc,
			QD.ICode, 
			QD.RowID, 
			SQty=0, 
			SBonus=0
		FROM 
			QuotationDetail QD 
		WHERE 
			QD.quotationcode BETWEEN :ar_QuotationCode1 AND :ar_QuotationCode2
		GROUP BY 
			QD.quotationcode,
			QD.itemflatdisc,
			QD.itemdescription,
			QD.gcode,
			QD.packunits,
			QD.saleprice,
			QD.salestax,  
			QD.unitsalestax,
			QD.GSTPErc,
			QD.Qty,
			QD.BonusQty,
			QD.discperc,
			QD.claimablediscperc,
			QD.ICode, 
			QD.RowID) T
	GROUP BY
		T.quotationcode,
		T.itemflatdisc,
		T.itemdescription,
		T.gcode,
		T.packunits,
		T.saleprice,
		T.salestax,  
		T.unitsalestax,
		T.GSTPErc,
		T.Qty,
		T.BonusQty,
		T.discperc,
		T.claimablediscperc,
		T.ICode, 
		T.RowID) S
WHERE 
	S.ICode = Item.ICode
order by 
	rowid
